title: R101 Disaster: Six Survived, Two Escaped From Inside
description: In 1930, R101 crashed near Beauvais on its first flight to India. Four survivors escaped external engine cars; Harry Leech and Arthur Disley came from inside the airship. The precise trigger of the first dive remains disputed.
